experiment_evidence_limits.interpretation: The early-finishing subset assesses quality cost only. It does not measure deadline coverage across 240 tasks; the competition rerun is a test of that hypothesis, not confirmation of it.

arc_agi_2.best_public_score_interpretation: Historical observed maximum, not a stable capability estimate or evidence for augment8.
arc_agi_2.latest_score_interpretation: Audited augment16 conservative baseline, submitted as version 11; no improvement claim.

scored_submission.outcome: Byte-identical to the first augment8 sample (56140934, 27.64). The predeclared gate '<= 28.0' fired: the refutation is solid at n=2 and dynamic-16/8 is dead.

ensemble_oracle.stores: agi2/out/v8 (4B) and agi2/out/exp-ep2/result (2B), 34 shared scoreable outputs
ensemble_oracle.outcome: The ceiling exists and the mechanism cannot reach any of it. The 2B ensemble is dead before being built; measured to be discarded rather than built to be measured.

arc_agi_2.latest_submission_what: v11 identical resubmit #4 (kernel version 11, no new run): one more draw from the 29.31/30.56/30.97 band

pre_objects_history.scope: Seven scored submissions before objects v3; includes different submission descriptions and is not asserted to be a single-code cohort.
pre_objects_history.interpretation: Descriptive observations only; neither the maximum nor the mean establishes stable capability or a treatment effect.

v2_repeated_runs.scope: Six runs grouped by the v2/resubmission descriptions in Kaggle history. Artifact hashes were not independently verified for this grouping.
v2_repeated_runs.interpretation: Descriptive observations only; neither the maximum nor the mean establishes stable capability or a treatment effect.

arc_agi_3.latest_score_interpretation: Seed 1 of the stable agent, local WORST of 5 (0.1177, 25 public games). Seed-ordering gate fired as predeclared; 0.21 is the project's highest ARC-AGI-3 score and is a draw, not a capability.

local_control_evidence.conclusion: Inconclusive. The originally cited +43% was one seed, not an established improvement. The objects submission decision did not meet the standard applied to warm.

arc_agi_3.latest_submission_what: stable agent, ARC_SEED default 3 (an unsampled draw; seeds 0/1/2 read 0.03/0.21/0.06 on the board)

seed_ordering_probe.reading: Local ordering does not transfer: the local-best seed scored lowest, the local-worst scored 7x higher. Local ARC-AGI-3 evaluation is retired as a ranking device.
seed_ordering_probe.board_determinism: Two byte-identical reruns at seed 0 returned 0.03 and 0.03; the board is deterministic given the seed. The 7x seed spread is a deterministic step function of the trajectory, not board noise.
seed_ordering_probe.resulting_policy: Use the daily ARC-AGI-3 slot to draw an unsampled seed of the stable agent and keep the best two scores across the competition.

limitations: Public leaderboard scores are not private final scores.
Local ARC-AGI-3 subset results do not estimate full competition performance.
Full notebook syntax validation was unavailable because the existing environment lacks IPython.
ARC-AGI-3 repeat submissions attributed to v2 span 0.01 to 0.18 (18x). This is Kaggle-side run variation, unaffected by the local seed fix; the observed maximum is not a capability estimate.

Pre-2026-09-10 local ARC-AGI-3 ablations did not control cross-process string hashing. Their comparative conclusions were retracted in paper/findings.md; they do not establish a reliable seed-variance distribution.
The objects-v3 local gain is not established by the corrected three-seed control. Neither an overlapping range nor a single leaderboard result establishes equivalence, superiority, or inferiority.

prepared_followup_round.execution_note: AGI2 paired public deadline runs analyzed using actual Kaggle public data (120 tasks,172 outputs). AGI3 v1 failed; replacement offline round launched after trajectory replay passed.
